collectr_world: Karel "Ash" World arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a letter he never sent and a borrowed coat two sizes too big. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Karel "Ash" World let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Karel "Ash" World found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: an old man with a dog, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
A man asked Karel "Ash" World to describe Old Harrow without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.

Karel "Ash" World keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a letter he never sent. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Karel "Ash" World watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Karel "Ash" World changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Machine-gun fire swept R-F6. Karel "Ash" World took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck).
Karel "Ash" World died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
Matthias World came to the front because his uncle Karel "Ash" World never came home. He carries a letter he never sent.
gndr_euphoria: Tobias Euphoria reached R-S4 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine. Tobias Euphoria asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a runner. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Tobias Euphoria's bunk. He has named it Little Sergeant. A letter from home reached Tobias Euphoria before dusk. Tobias Euphoria read it twice and slept a little easier.
jacksondeehring: Isidor Jacksondeehr arrived on Day 5 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

Isidor Jacksondeehr tipped water from a boot and a small beetle climbed out. At least one passenger had enjoyed the crossing. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Isidor Jacksondeehr watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Isidor Jacksondeehr tried to remember the price of a loaf in Port Abel. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Isidor Jacksondeehr closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Isidor Jacksondeehr saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-F21 and fired once. Rafael Broadshoulde was grazed.
lud0_retarded: Day 6: Zeno Retarded reached S-S6 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Zeno Retarded lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.

Zeno Retarded and Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it. A letter from home found Zeno Retarded before the night shift. Zeno Retarded folded it small and kept it close.
scottjseale: Gustav Scottjseale took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Gustav Scottjseale added a leak above the man's head in pencil. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Scottjseale. Gustav Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Quentin Arvidgrubb and Gustav Scottjseale sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Scottjseale. Gustav Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F20. Gustav Scottjseale has learned to walk bent double.

Gustav Scottjseale drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Scottjseale. Gustav Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav Scottjseale bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Scottjseale. Gustav Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav Scottjseale had just lit a cigarette at R-F20 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Jonas Hill of the Hegemony (@_strawberry.hill_). Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Scottjseale. Gustav Scottjseale read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
